title: Johny Johny Yes Papa 🐙 Clap Clap Hooray! | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: Johny, Johny! Yes, Papa! Ollie the octopus plays Johny and answers Papa's questions all day long, from wake up to shoes, toast, playing outside, sharing, helping a friend and a bedtime hug. A sing-along call and response for toddlers and preschoolers with kind words and a happy clap-clap-hooray chorus.
actions: Ask each question in a big Papa voice and answer Yes, Papa!
Stretch and sneeze when Johny wakes up
Slide, slide, slide with your hand
Open your arms for the bedtime hug
credit: Original song by Tiny Tune Town: new words and music.
